title: Theory core I: generic graphs, walks and holonomy with Lemma 6.2, Thm 6.3, Thm 6.4 and Cor 6.5 kernel-checked in Lean in their textbook form and in Bend in the per-step form an instance applies, basis sufficiency of the header instantiated by application over I24's PROVED laws (Thm 6.4 (ii) in potential form), with certificates for obligations no rule states and a semantic canary

predictions.claim: The Bend theory core is PROVED: gen/M3/theory/core/LAWS.bend is exactly the 19 frozen statements of spec/M3/lib/theory_core.json (core.laws_text: the walk algebra core_runto_functional/append/split/rev; Thm 6.4 and Cor 6.5 in per-step form core_transport, core_cycle_identity, core_parallel_agree, core_holonomy_parallel, core_bwd_cons, core_fundamental_potential; non-vacuity core_cons_inhabited; Thm 6.3 core_domain_into/onto; Lemma 6.2 core_cong_sym/trans, core_whisker_post/pre; helpers core_efq_bool, core_nat_eq_of_is_eq), and its PROOF.bend (hand-written once, emitted as fixed text by holon.gen.theory: gap T-G7) fills every law with no escape hatch and is accepted by bend and by bend --verdict, each within 120 s of wall clock on an otherwise idle machine.

The Lean theory core checks: gen/M3/theory/lean/Theory.lean keeps the frozen definitions (no namespace, autoImplicit off) and declares each of the 9 frozen theorems once with exactly its frozen statement (lemma_6_2; thm_6_3_into, thm_6_3_onto, thm_6_3_local, the localization: a walk that carries a value of R outside R has a single step, taken from a value its prefix keeps in R, that leaves R; thm_6_4_iii_i, thm_6_4_i_ii, thm_6_4_ii_iii over a connected, domain-coherent invertible fragment with a spanning tree; cor_6_5_potentials, cor_6_5_flat), adds after the marker only theorems, defs and examples (rule T2: no instance, attribute, variable, open, namespace, section, string or other command that changes how a statement elaborates), and holon.lean.check_text under the pinned Lean 4.34.0 returns checked with every theorem audited by its bare name, axioms within {propext, Quot.sound}, within 120 s.

The header instantiation is PROVED by application: for each version v in 0, 1, 2, gen/M3/theory/basis/header_length_v<v>/LAWS.bend is the frozen text (the law basis_sufficient_header_length_v<v>: for every h, any two forward walks of the instance graph from vertex 0 that end at one vertex carry start(h) = K0{pin_h(h)} to the same value; and its 4 certificates), and its PROOF.bend, generated by holon.gen.basis with holon.gen.congruence, obeys rule T7 (exact imports; avail_<i> applying each available equation's PROVED law; edge_<k> per edge, a tree edge by {==} and a non-tree edge by its cycle's derivation; the instance law applying core_parallel_agree; each certificate applying the instance law; model records written only in bridge_* pin or getter equations) and is accepted by bend and by bend --verdict, each within 120 s. Decided by the kernels alone, not by report.json.

The semantic canary: the instantiation is not vacuous, because its pins matter. For each version v, gen/M3/theory/basis/header_length_v<v>/canary/LAWS.bend is the frozen text (the instance's carriers, zero, sigma and edge maps verbatim, and the counter-law canary_unpinned_header_length_v<v>: some root record h with the unpinned start K0{h} separates the root cycle's walks, edge 1 against edges 0 then 2), and its PROOF.bend fills it with a witness found by evaluating the model with bend on candidate records (rule T8b; never an oracle), writes a model record only in witness_* defs, and is accepted by bend and by bend --verdict, each within 120 s.

regressions.claim: I42 adds no law and changes no record: every commit that writes gen/M3/theory/ or holon/gen/{basis,theory,congruence}.py touches nothing under laws/, results/, facts/, spec/M1/, spec/M2/, replay/, gen/M0-M2, or gen/M3 outside gen/M3/theory/.

Construction: spec/M3/lib/theory_core.json is tests_m3/_i42.py::theory_doc over unchanged inputs (files by sha256, records by status); the frozen statements are well-typed (the Bend core: 19 open laws; each instance beside the core and its root law's file: 25; each canary beside its root law's file: 2; Lean: 9 placeholder warnings, no error, and 9 axiom-audit lines by bare name); the instrument's instance values are those I42-R6 names.

Construction: holon basis --milestone M3 is deterministic (two runs byte-identical, equal to the committed gen/M3/theory/ but report.json), leaves files outside core/, lean/ and basis/ alone, --check passes on the committed tree, and a used law's generated LAWS.bend with a stale statement_hash is refused (exit 2, "holon basis: refused:", the law named, nothing written).

Construction (honesty): an UNKNOWN round trip leaves exactly its field's cycle uncovered and its instance without files (v1 with L_par_rt_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_BatchHeaderBytes_DataHash_v1 UNKNOWN: edge 23, the root field BatchHeaderV0.DataHash's Some edge); an UNKNOWN root law removes its version's instance; holon/gen/basis.py, theory.py and congruence.py name no target, fixture or law, import no instrument and enter no generator closure.

Gates: holon gate --milestone M3 --checks G3,G5,G9,GEVID passes on a copy of the built tree (G3 scans gen/M3/theory/'s .bend files). G2 and G11 already fail at the prereg for reasons outside I42 (solc 0.8.24 is not installed in this environment; I30's record L_sort_realize_rollup_363_4a64383b is missing, reported by I25), so they are excluded and stated.

Construction: gen/M3/theory/basis/header_length.json equals the instrument key for key, inputs included: three instances rooted at the three PROVED pinned cross-component laws, (|V|, |E|, rank) = (34, 55, 22) at v0 and (37, 60, 24) at v1 and v2, kappa 1, every fundamental cycle covered (uncovered []), 23 + 25 + 25 laws available (exactly the 73 PROVED PAR laws of M3, each in one instance), 22 + 24 + 24 of them needed by a shortest derivation, canary edge 2 in each.

Construction canary (BUILD_PLAN's "a canary that drops one cycle law is rejected"): each instance's PROOF.bend with edge_2's fact (the cycle of the second encoder, whose law is the root cross-component law) proved by {==} instead of its derivation fails under bend, first error an expected/observed mismatch located in edge_2. A construction check: on a symbolic record the dropped fact cannot hold by computation.

Construction: in the built document and LAWS.bend files, the six constant_read certificates are exactly I25's six uncovered constant_read elements (reason no_rule: BatchHeaderBytes_Version of the Go encoders = 0x00, 0x01, 0x02 and BatchHeaderBytes_SequencerSetVerifyHash of enc_sol = 32 zero bytes at v0, v1, v2, each on the pinned region, gap T-G2), and the six weak_image certificates are the decoder pairs of I24's three PAR-weak laws on both encoders' images; their kernel check is I42-P3's.

Construction: gen/M3/theory/report.json binds the committed files' sha256 to every kernel result (bend and verdict checked for the core, the 3 instances and the 3 canaries; Lean checked), labels each instance kernel_checked and each canary refuted.

thresholds.budget_clock: wall clock, measured by the tests, on an otherwise idle machine
thresholds.semantic_canary: per instance, the counter-law canary_unpinned_<role>_v<v> in basis/<role>_v<v>/canary/, proved with a witness found on the model (rule T8b)
thresholds.construction_canary: the instance PROOF.bend with edge_<k> (k = the lowest-id covered non-tree edge) proved by {==}: rejected by bend, first error an expected/observed mismatch located in edge_<k> (rule T8a)
thresholds.placement: gen/M3/theory/ (not holon.gen.core's catalog); the congruence class in holon/gen/congruence.py (not holon/gen/mproofs.py, a generator-closure root): gap T-G5
thresholds.by_application: rule T7: exact imports; avail_<i> applies equation i's law; edge_<k> by {==} (tree) or by naming its derivation's avail_<i>; the instance law applies core_parallel_agree; certificates apply the instance law; model records written only in bridge_* pin or getter equations
thresholds.hand_proofs: gap T-G7: the Lean and Bend core proofs are hand-written once and emitted as fixed text (BUILD_PLAN I42 with Q14b); instance proofs are generated
